messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up — NorthBridge Health showing a pretty steep usage drop (~60% in 3 weeks) after their procurement/PM change. Procurement told Renewals they're running a competitive check (VeloxAI). Can we triage risk and next steps? I grabbed quick metrics below.

caleb_ae: Thanks Maria. Noted. Do we know which routes dropped (embed vs chat)? Any spikes in errors or latency that could explain churn?

priya_customer: FYI — procurement reached out asking for an apples-to-apples cost + latency comparison. They said the new PM prioritizes price and infra simplicity. We're still active on the POC but engagement is cooling.

jorge_se: I'll take a config + telemetry audit. Quick glance at org metrics: kv-cache hit rate plummeted after a model rollout last month, and batch sizes look smaller. Could be a change in client library or a pinned model variant. Can you confirm model_id and recent deploys?

maria_cs: Model on their dedicated cluster is rbw-open-7b-v2 (pinned). Recent deploy timestamp: 2152200000. Quick metrics I pulled from the console: 
```
weekly_tokens:
  week_1: 4_200_000
  week_2: 3_100_000
  week_3: 1_600_000
kv_cache_hit_rate: 12% (was ~58% pre-rollout)
avg_latency_p95: 180ms -> 210ms
error_rate: 0.6% (stable)
```

caleb_ae: Good data. I'll assemble a short one-pager: cost delta vs VeloxAI, recommended fallback (keep pinned model + enable prefix caching), and a canary rollback play if needed. Can you confirm procurement meeting time window?

priya_customer: Thursday 10am PT is when procurement runs vendor calls. They've asked us for a 10–15 min summary + cost snapshot.

jorge_se: Plan: 1) verify whether client started sending context differently (smaller batch keys), 2) check autoscaler logs for any throttling, 3) compare model variants for quantization changes. I'll post findings by EOD.

maria_cs: Actions: Jorge — config/telemetry audit EOD. Caleb — one-pager + cost comp by tomorrow morning. I'll book the 10am PT slot and prep slides. Priya — please surface any procurement scoring rubric if you have it.

renewals-bot: Reminder: NorthBridge Health renewal date 2026-05-07 (43 days). Link: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/northbridge

caleb_ae: I'll draft the playbook and ping legal for any discount guardrails.

maria_cs: Thanks all — let's reconvene after Jorge's audit. :thumbsup:
